Former CIA officer Andrew Bustamante returns to Danny Jones to discuss UFOs. Bustamante spent seven years as a covert operative for the agency. He also served as an Air Force combat veteran.

Jones calls him one of his favorite guests of all time. Bustamante now teaches spy skills for daily life. Here he applies a spy's habits to reports of strange craft. He asks what proof would settle the question. The episode suits listeners who want the UFO debate handled by a trained skeptic with field experience. His answers stay measured, even on wild claims.

Drug researcher Hamilton Morris joins Danny Jones to talk about DARPA drug work, psychedelic toad venom, and why VICE fell. Morris is a chemist and TV host known for his show on drugs of all kinds. He brings a lab mind to wild lore.

Morris tells what toad venom does to the mind and why labs care. He talks about state funds for drug work and the lines that work can cross. He also gives his take on the fall of VICE, where he once starred. Listeners get a sharp, strange tour from a true drug nerd. The library files the talk as an archive record.
